title: 第23章 金主潜我（3）-《反派BOSS有毒》
content:
第(1/3)页

    原微博是一个叫‘睡不醒的猫猫’发的，内容很简洁——剧外惊现剧内情景。

    配着一个惊恐的表情，然后就是一个手机拍摄的小视屏。

    视屏内容正是时笙在厕所打林姗姗的画面，前面和后面都被剪掉了。

    有好几个影响力不错的大V转发，一些网友扒出两人正在拍摄的电视剧，然后对应发布的剧照，再结合原著，很快就有人得出了自以为的真相。

    下方无数的网友开始@她的微博，并加以正义的声讨，林姗姗的粉丝纷纷涌向原主的微博，骂得可难听了。

    “怎么会有这么恶毒的女人，之前看她演的那部爱情剧就觉得她演技好烂，现在人品还这么烂，欺负我们姗姗，江晚滚出娱乐圈。”

    “打脸是戏里情节需要，姗姗女神就算真打你那也是为了更好的拍摄效果，你凭什么在戏外打回来？戏里戏外都分不清，当什么演员，江晚滚出娱乐圈。”

    “现在的新人太不尊重前辈了，一点素质都没有，果断路转黑。”

    “江晚道歉，滚出娱乐圈。”

    说得难听的什么都有，问候全家都是轻的。

    这些人躲在网线后面，真相是什么他们根本不在乎，拎着一点自以为是的真相就开始胡说八道，还能帮你把背景补全。

    不过半个小时，#江晚道歉，滚出娱乐圈#就被顶上了热搜。

    越来越多的人涌向她微博下面。

    网友的脑洞是无限大的。

    用江晚的那句话——这个世界上最恶毒就是人心，它能将你一夕间捧上天堂，也能将你一夕间打入地狱。

    时笙没有回应网上的事，她知道自己越是回应，这些人就蹦哒得越欢，更何况，还有公司顶着。

    果然，很快米兰就打来了电话，语气生硬，极为不乐意的说完要求，大约意思是让她什么都别回，公司那边会处理。

    时笙对此表示，资源不用白不用。

    ……

    林姗姗的事处理得极快，但也可以看出米兰对她的不用心，不过是用公司另外的艺人将这条热度盖过去了，根本就没有要帮她正名的意思。

    时笙越发坚定要离开东方娱乐。

    合约是三年期限，如今她刚签约不到半年，还有两年半的时间，想要离开就得付违约金，那违约金可不是她现在付得起的。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The original Weibo was posted by a person named ‘Cat that can’t wake up’, and the content was very concise – a scene from the play was revealed outside the play.

Paired with a frightened expression, there is a small video screen shot by a mobile phone.

The content of the video was exactly the scene of Shi Sheng hitting Lin Shanshan in the toilet. The front and back were cut out.

There were several influential big Vs who forwarded it. Some netizens picked out the TV series the two were filming, and then matched the released stills, combined with the original work, and soon someone came up with what they thought was the truth.

Countless netizens below began to @her Weibo and denounced her righteously. Fans of Lin Shanshan flocked to the original owner's Weibo and scolded her in a very unpleasant way.

"How could there be such a vicious woman? I thought her acting skills were terrible when I watched the romantic drama she acted in. Now her character is still so bad. She bullied us Shanshan. Jiang Wan should get out of the entertainment industry."

"Slapping in the face is necessary for the plot in the play. Even if Goddess Shanshan really hits you, it is for better filming effects. Why do you slap her back outside the play? You can't tell the difference between the inside and outside of the play. What kind of actor do you want to be? Jiang Wan, get out of the entertainment industry."

“Today’s newcomers have too little respect for their seniors, they have no quality at all, and they will take a decisive turn to the dark side.”

"Jiang Wan apologizes and gets out of the entertainment industry."

There are all kinds of unpleasant things to say, but all greetings to the whole family are light.

These people hide behind network cables. They don’t care what the truth is. They start talking nonsense with a little bit of self-righteous truth, and they can also help you complete the background.

In less than half an hour, #江万 apologize, get out of the entertainment industry # became the top trending search topic.

More and more people are flocking to her Weibo post.

Netizens’ imaginations are infinite.

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​The most vicious thing in the world is the human heart. It can lift you to heaven overnight, or it can send you to hell overnight.

Shi Sheng didn’t respond to what happened online. She knew that the more she responded, the happier these people would be. What’s more, the company was still supporting them.

Sure enough, Milan called her soon after, with a stiff tone and an extremely unhappy request. She probably told her not to reply and the company would handle it.

Shi Sheng said that resources are not used in vain.

……

Lin Shanshan's matter was handled very quickly, but it can also be seen that Milan didn't care about her. He just used other artists in the company to cover up the heat and had no intention of helping her clear her name.

Shi Sheng became more and more determined to leave Oriental Entertainment.

The contract is for three years. Now she has just signed it for less than half a year, and there are still two and a half years to go. If she wants to leave, she will have to pay liquidated damages, which she cannot afford now.
